name: Release Sentinel
description: Zero-config semantic versioning, conventional commit parser, and automated GitHub release notes generator with monorepo tag isolation.
author: alexrivera
readme:
# Release Sentinel

Automated **semantic versioning** and *changelog generation* designed for zero-maintenance [GitHub Actions](https://docs.github.com/en/actions) pipelines.

> **Note:** Release Sentinel requires `contents: write` permission in your workflow token to tag commits and publish release assets.

## Quick Start

1. Run the interactive initializer in your repository root.
2. Commit the generated `.github/workflows/release.yml` workflow.
3. Push any [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) to `main`.

```bash
npx @forgehub/release-sentinel init --workflow
```

## CLI Flags & Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--workflow` | `boolean` | `true` | Scaffolds the GitHub Actions YAML workflow |
| `--dry-run` | `boolean` | `false` | Computes next SemVer bump without pushing tags |
| `--changelog-file` | `string` | `CHANGELOG.md` | Output file path for generated release notes |

## GitHub Actions Configuration

Add the following step to `.github/workflows/release.yml`:

```yaml
name: Release Pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Run Release Sentinel
        uses: forgehub-registry/release-sentinel@v2.4.1
        with:
          dry-run: false
          changelog-file: CHANGELOG.md
```

## Key Capabilities

- **Strict Commit Parsing:** Evaluates `feat:`, `fix:`, and `BREAKING CHANGE:` commits per *Conventional Commits 1.0.0*.
- **Automated Manifest Sync:** Calculates the next SemVer bump and updates `package.json` or `plugins.json`.
- **Contributor Attribution:** Generates categorized Markdown release notes with commit SHA links.

name: Command Palette Zero
description: Dependency-free, WAI-ARIA compliant command menu and fuzzy launcher built as a 3.8kB Custom Element for static sites and documentation hubs.
author: sarakim
readme:
# Command Palette Zero

Drop-in `<forge-cmdk>` **Web Component** with *sub-millisecond* fuzzy scoring, full keyboard navigation, and dark/light CSS custom properties.

> Built on native [Custom Elements v1](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_custom_elements) with **zero external dependencies** and `3.8kB` brotli size.

## CDN Installation

Paste the module script tag into your `<head>`:

```html
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@forgehub/cmdk-zero@1.8.0/dist/cmdk.min.js"></script>
```

## Usage Example

```javascript
const palette = document.querySelector('forge-cmdk');

palette.setCommands([
  {
    id: 'copy-url',
    title: 'Copy Current Page URL',
    section: 'Actions',
    shortcut: 'Mod+Shift+C',
    handler: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.href)
  },
  {
    id: 'toggle-theme',
    title: 'Toggle Dark / Light Appearance',
    section: 'Preferences',
    shortcut: 'Mod+J',
    handler: () => document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark')
  }
]);
```

## Keyboard Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Context | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K` | Global | Toggle command palette modal visibility |
| `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` | Open Modal | Navigate filtered command items |
| `Enter` | Open Modal | Execute highlighted command handler |
| `Escape` | Open Modal | Dismiss palette and restore focus |

name: EnvVault CLI
description: Portable command-line utility that encrypts local .env files using AES-256-GCM so secrets can be safely committed to version control.
author: marcuschen
readme:
# EnvVault CLI

Commit encrypted `.env.vault` snapshots **directly to Git** and decrypt them in *CI/CD* or local environments with a single master key.

> **Security Guarantee:** Zero plaintext disk writes occur during `env-vault exec`—variables are decrypted strictly in process memory.

## One-Line Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://get.forgehub.dev/env-vault | sh
```

## Core Workflow

1. **Initialize Vault:** Generate a project encryption key and create `.env.vault`.
2. **Lock Secrets:** Encrypt local `.env.production` changes before committing.
3. **Execute Process:** Run your server with decrypted secrets injected into memory.

```bash
# 1. Generate a project encryption key and initialize .env.vault
env-vault init --env .env.production

# 2. Encrypt local changes into the committed .env.vault file
env-vault lock --input .env.production --output .env.vault

# 3. Execute any process with decrypted secrets injected in memory
ENV_VAULT_KEY="vlt_9f8a..." env-vault exec -- node server.js
```

## Cryptographic Specifications

- **Cipher Suite:** Authenticated `AES-256-GCM` with unique 96-bit nonces per lock operation.
- **Key Derivation:** `HKDF-SHA256` per environment stage (`development`, `staging`, `production`).
